answer: Each epoch opens with fresh randomness nobody can predict. Each identity solves a memory-hard puzzle bound to that randomness and its key, a jetty of 45 minutes' work, verified in 50 milliseconds. No pre-mining, no parallelizing per identity. Attestation lasts 15 minutes; a fake finishing an hour in is already too late. Verifiers reject a wrong-randomness or late proof, mark it violet, and quarantine it three epochs; a second one burns its bond and revokes it. Forging 10,000 identities takes 7,500 CPU-hours, about $300, and still misses the window; a gale of fakes stays stranded.
